acts.palette: Leaf green, madder red, woad blue, cream, brass, teal
acts.map: Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at joints, lit like a shadow theatre; no logos, readable text or real people. Tall vertical overhead papercraft garden diorama, read bottom to top: stripped rectangular dye beds and potted seedlings at the bottom, branching pale gravel paths between orderly green beds in the open middle, and a mobile glasshouse in a clear clearing at the top where the Grand Curator waits. Fine teal hexagonal growth follows the paths toward the glasshouse. Keep the middle ground open for readable path lines.
backdrops: Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at joints, lit like a shadow theatre; no logos, readable text or real people. Wide, low-contrast garden fight background with no central subject: muted green dye beds, cream gravel and distant leaf silhouettes along the edges; a few small teal hexagonal patches touch a corner.

Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at joints, lit like a shadow theatre; no logos, readable text or real people. Wide, low-contrast garden fight background with no central subject: faded plant beds and fogged glasshouse panels at the edges, with teal hexagonal growth creeping across the ground and up the frames; open quiet centre.

Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at joints, lit like a shadow theatre; no logos, readable text or real people. Wide, low-contrast garden fight background with no central subject: dim glasshouse frames and wilted vines recede at the edges, broad connected teal hexagonal growth covers much of the ground and climbs the panes; subdued open centre.
acts.boss: Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at joints, lit like a shadow theatre; no logos, readable text or real people. Grand Curator, imposing full-body portrait: a towering peaked greenhouse body of fogged cream glass panes in a brass frame, green vines and a roll of dyed cloth visible inside, standing on splayed black iron root legs. A broad brass shield projects from one side. Low viewpoint, strong peaked silhouette, all limbs visible against a simple muted garden backdrop.

acts.palette: Iron charcoal, timber brown, cream, indigo, ochre, teal
acts.map: Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at joints, lit like a shadow theatre; no logos, readable text or real people. Tall vertical overhead papercraft mill diorama, read bottom to top: dye vats at the bottom, wooden wheels, belts and separated looms lining the sides of an open central floor, then a clear raised platform at the top where the Thread City Engine waits. Cream cloth winds upward through the mill and teal hexagonal growth spreads along the machinery. Leave open middle ground for readable path lines.
backdrops: Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at joints, lit like a shadow theatre; no logos, readable text or real people. Wide, low-contrast mill fight background with no central subject: muted timber beams, distant spinning wheels and shallow dye vats at the edges, with a few teal hexagons near the floor; open centre.

Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at joints, lit like a shadow theatre; no logos, readable text or real people. Wide, low-contrast mill fight background with no central subject: dim looms and hanging cream cloth border an open floor, teal hexagonal growth creeping over belts and up wooden posts.

Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at joints, lit like a shadow theatre; no logos, readable text or real people. Wide, low-contrast mill fight background with no central subject: shadowed loom frames and sheets of cream cloth at the edges, large connected teal hexagonal growth spreading across the floor, belts and walls; keep the centre quiet and readable.
acts.boss: Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at joints, lit like a shadow theatre; no logos, readable text or real people. Thread City Engine, imposing full-body portrait: a towering iron loom with two wooden house-shaped housings rising from its shoulders, a broad horizontal shuttle spanning its body and a long roll of cream cloth draped over its shoulders. Heavy iron feet planted wide, visible brass joint pins, low viewpoint and unmistakable house-roof silhouette against a simple muted mill backdrop.

acts.palette: Ivory, indigo, ochre, dark walnut, brass, teal
acts.map: Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at joints, lit like a shadow theatre; no logos, readable text or real people. Tall vertical overhead papercraft textile museum diorama, read bottom to top: a partly covered doorway and worktables at the bottom, framed textile fragments and tan map sheets around an open gallery in the middle, and a clear central-frame chamber at the top where the Composite Curator waits. Cream cloth connects the rooms while teal hexagonal growth spreads toward the chamber. Keep the middle open for readable path lines; map sheets have lines but no writing.
backdrops: Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at joints, lit like a shadow theatre; no logos, readable text or real people. Wide, low-contrast textile gallery fight background with no central subject: muted ivory walls, distant wooden display frames and folded textile fragments along the edges, with a few teal hexagonal patches near the doorway; open centre.

Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at joints, lit like a shadow theatre; no logos, readable text or real people. Wide, low-contrast textile gallery fight background with no central subject: subdued frames, loose cream sheets and indigo fragments around an open floor; teal hexagonal growth creeps along the walls and over display mounts.

Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at joints, lit like a shadow theatre; no logos, readable text or real people. Wide, low-contrast textile gallery fight background with no central subject: dim wooden frames and draped textile fragments at the edges, much of the gallery wrapped in a connected teal hexagonal covering climbing walls and crossing the floor; quiet open centre.
acts.boss: Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and brass pins at joints, lit like a shadow theatre; no logos, readable text or real people. Composite Curator, imposing full-body portrait: a towering dark walnut and brass loom frame with long jointed legs, draped in irregular indigo, cream and ochre textile fragments joined by visible seams. A wide swinging wooden shuttle extends across its body, and fine map-like lines without writing cross its cloth. Low viewpoint, broad angular silhouette, all limbs visible against a simple muted gallery backdrop.
